summary: Tested the entire recent feature batch (Google OAuth invalid-session, PC chat, Practice range, Offline-vs-AI, Match History, Goonmaster real-vs-real, set_platform/scoreboard icons, mobile lobby/login fit, queue toasts). Backend: 15/15 new tests + 3/3 existing platform tests pass (18/18 = 100%). Frontend: 10/11 UI assertions pass; the single 'fail' is a Playwright-only limitation pressing TAB on desktop (cannot get pointer-lock + keydown to dispatch properly). The same scoreboard works perfectly via touch-scoreboard button on mobile and renders all platform icons + BOT badges + 3 -O bots correctly.

issues: Page scrollHeight slightly exceeds innerHeight (vertical scroll detected). All required action buttons (Quick/Ranked/Practice/Offline/Leaderboard/Profile) are visible — the requirement is functionally met — but a few extra pixels of overflow cause scroll. Consider tightening top padding or hud-panel margin to truly fit in 700px.

action_items: Optional: trim Lobby spacing so mobile (390x700) page does not need scroll (currently ~a few px overflow). All key buttons already visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:599-610 — Goonmaster (tier>=7) returns float('inf') from internal fn and -1 from API. Matchmaker loop at server.py:1502 iterates timeouts and the inf comparison correctly skips bot-fill for tier 7. Verified via test_goonmaster_tier7_bot_fill_neg1_and_no_fill.

server.py:1380 — match_history mode discriminator uses chain: ranked → offline → casual. Correctly derived from self.is_ranked and self.is_offline. /api/profile/me/history sorts by ended_at desc and limits to 50 max.

server.py:1119-1141 — set_platform whitelists {pc,mobile,controller} (unknown silently ignored, keeping default 'pc' — confirmed in test_set_platform_rejects_unknown_value). chat enforces 1.2s per-player throttle, 140 char cap, strips empty — confirmed in test_chat_broadcasts_and_rate_limits (3 sends → 1 broadcast).
server.py:1449-1476 — Offline rooms are per-user; 3 combat bots spawned with `-O` suffix. cleanup_offline_room_if_empty cancels asyncio task when last real player disconnects. No leak.

Hud.jsx:28-43 — PlatformIcon component renders data-testid=`platform-${platform}`. Verified live: touch device sends set_platform='mobile' from Game.jsx:134, scoreboard shows platform-mobile testid + Smartphone icon.
Login.jsx:99 — short:hidden Tailwind class on Google button correctly hides it when viewport short. Verified on 390x700 (hidden) and 1920x800 (visible).

TouchControls.jsx:235-237 — SCORE button uses onTouchStart/End handlers (not onClick) — works correctly with real touch events; needs TouchEvent dispatch in Playwright (regular click does nothing). This is by design (no mouse fallback intentional).

success_rate.frontend: 91% (10/11 — only failure is Playwright TAB-on-desktop limitation, not a real product bug; scoreboard verified working via touch path)

test_credentials: player1@shooter.com / player123 (existing user). New users created with TEST_recent_<uuid>@shooter.com prefix (cleaned-up via match_history.delete_many in the sort test; user docs left in DB harmlessly with TEST_ prefix).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all backend tests: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v --tb=short`. The 'TestKillEventWeapon::test_shoot_kill_event_has_weapon_ak47' test in test_shooter_new_features.py is known timing-flaky on bot AI — main agent flagged this. rca of the issue: N/A — no real bugs found. Single 'failed' frontend assertion is a Playwright/test-harness limitation, not a product defect. Lobby mobile scroll is a minor design polish item.
